question: What is the average loss of each policy by policy number where loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?

FROM

LEFT JOIN 
    oda_benchmark.acme_policy_coverage_detail pcd ON p.policy_identifier = pcd.policy_identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    oda_benchmark.acme_claim_coverage cc ON pcd.policy_coverage_detail_identifier = cc.policy_coverage_detail_identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    oda_benchmark.acme_claim_amount ca ON cc.claim_identifier = ca.claim_identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT claim_amount_identifier, SUM(claim_amount) AS loss_payment_amount FROM oda_benchmark.acme_claim_amount WHERE claim_amount_identifier IN (SELECT claim_amount_identifier FROM oda_benchmark.acme_loss_payment) GROUP BY claim_amount_identifier) lp ON ca.claim_amount_identifier = lp.claim_amount_identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT claim_amount_identifier, SUM(claim_amount) AS loss_reserve_amount FROM oda_benchmark.acme_claim_amount WHERE claim_amount_identifier IN (SELECT claim_amount_identifier FROM oda_benchmark.acme_loss_reserve) GROUP BY claim_amount_identifier) lr ON ca.claim_amount_identifier = lr.claim_amount_identifier
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT claim_amount_identifier, SUM(claim_amount) AS expense_payment_amount FROM oda_benchmark.acme_claim_amount WHERE claim_amount_identifier IN (SELECT claim_amount_identifier FROM oda_benchmark.acme_expense_payment) GROUP BY claim_amount_identifier) ep ON ca.claim_amount_identifier = ep.claim_amount_identifier
LEFT JOIN

GROUP BY 
    p.policy_number
ORDER BY 
    average_loss DESC;
gold_sql:

  SELECT ca.claim_identifier,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.claim_amount_identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.claim_amount END), 0) +
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.claim_amount_identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.claim_amount END), 0) +
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.claim_amount_identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.claim_amount END), 0) +
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.claim_amount_identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.claim_amount END), 0) AS full_loss

JOIN oda_benchmark.acme_claim_coverage cc ON c.claim_identifier = cc.claim_identifier
